abstract: Covers the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, AI RMF 1.0 (NIST AI 100-1, January 2023): framing AI risk and risk tolerance, the seven trustworthy AI characteristics, the GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE and MANAGE functions with all 72 categories and subcategories, use-case, temporal and cross-sectoral profiles, and the AI RMF Playbook's suggested actions as published. The genai-profile family covers NIST AI 600-1 (July 2024): the 12 generative AI risks and the 213 suggested actions it maps to 49 subcategories, plus its primary considerations on governance, pre-deployment testing, structured public feedback, content provenance and incident disclosure. Both lines are current; the announced AI RMF revision, the critical infrastructure profile, the Cyber AI Profile and the SP 800-53 AI control overlays are tracked as watch items because none has final text. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out versions, GOVERN and MAP, trustworthiness with MEASURE and MANAGE, the Generative AI Profile, and building a profile with control mapping. Not legal advice.
